compressed_energy_proof: Q and Qdot commute with Pf. The diagonal energy form is the compression of the full energy form, hence <=mu Q. D(Ay)-D(Aw) has Q norm <=delta_diagonal. The comparison propagator has norm <=exp((30+delta_diagonal) dt), without a similarity prefactor.

fast_transfer_proof: Actual full Phi_y has Q norm <=3 exp(30 dt). Variation of constants using the diagonal comparison and retained full fast response gives ||y_other(t)||_Q<=3 kappa t exp(gamma t)||y_fast(0)||_Q/ell for a mathematical initial fast component; physical initial data are not changed.
inverse_proof: For off-block V, T2^-1=(I-V/ell^2)(I-V^2/ell^4)^-1. Q-block even and odd inverse norms are <=1/(1-r^2) and r/(1-r^2); r<=r_upper<1.
